data.description: Participant must sign ICF, be eligible, and be registered on Day -7 to be considered enrolled
data.text: "Enrolled" means all participants who sign the informed consent form (ICF), are eligible for the study, and are registered on Day -7 when participants are assigned a participant number.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Before Dose Titration
data.description: Safety Review Committee must review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29
data.text: Before titration to 30 mg/day, the Safety Review Committee (SRC) will review available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Safety Concern Precluding Dose Escalation
data.description: Participants may remain at 15 mg/day for the duration of study if escalation would pose undue risk
data.text: Dosing for ALXN1840 will be initiated at 15 mg once daily for a minimum of 4 weeks, with an increase to 30 mg after 4 weeks, unless there are safety concerns that, in the opinion of the Investigator(s) and/or Alexion, may place participants at undue risk, in which case, participants may remain on the 15 mg/day dose for the duration of the study.

data.name: Adaptive Design Features
data.description: Adaptive features may be implemented at Investigator discretion within pre-specified limits without protocol amendment
data.text: This study incorporates the use of an adaptive design. Adaptive features may be implemented at the discretion of the Investigator to support conduct of the study. Such adaptive features do not require amendment of the protocol. Adaptive features and their limits are described in Table 4.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Condition
data.description: Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to 14 additional days with Investigator approval; additional IP provided and actual duration recorded; participant continues Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23
data.text: To ensure flexibility, the Outpatient Period during Treatment Period 1 may be extended up to an additional 14 days with Investigator approval. In this situation, participants will be given additional investigational product to support daily dosing throughout the Outpatient Period. In such cases, the actual Outpatient Period duration will be recorded and the participant will continue Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Retention in CRU During Outpatient Period
data.description: At CRU discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the Outpatient Period for safety or study conduct integrity
data.text: At the CRU's discretion, participants may remain in the CRU during the outpatient period for safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Negative Pregnancy Test Required for Enrollment of WOCBP
data.description: Women of childbearing potential may only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test at Screening
data.text: Menstruation check is for women only; women of childbearing potential should only be enrolled after a negative serum pregnancy test result at Screening.

data.name: Bilirubin/ALT Liver Injury Criterion
data.description: Bilirubin > 2 x ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 x ULN indicative of liver injury requires temporary interruption
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: Temporary interruption; weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Hematologic Decline Criterion
data.description: Greater than 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline triggers dose reduction and no further increases until resolution
data.text: > 30% ↓ from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: Reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose ↑ until resolution of abnormality. Weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Neurological Worsening Assessment
data.description: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or neurologic physical exam triggers Investigator/Medical Monitor evaluation of dose modification
data.text: Evidence of neurologic worsening by AEs or by neurologic physical exam assessment: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data. Rationale for dosing decision must be documented in study record and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Psychiatric Worsening Assessment
data.description: Clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening (suicidality, acute depression, psychosis) triggers dose modification evaluation
data.text: Evidence of clinically significant acute psychiatric worsening which may include but not limited to suicidality, acute depression, or psychosis: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease).

data.name: Rechallenge Limits
data.description: Maximum of 3 rechallenges allowed; participants on 15 mg QOD rechallenged at 15 mg QOD; bilirubin rechallenge requires Medical Monitor approval
data.text: A maximum of 3 rechallenges will be allowed. For rechallenges, participants who were on 15 mg QOD should be rechallenged at the 15 mg QOD dose. Rechallenge under these conditions requires approval of the Alexion Medical Monitor.

data.name: Clinically Significant ECG/QTcF Finding After Enrollment
data.description: Investigator determines whether participant can continue in study if a clinically significant finding (eg, QTcF change from baseline) is identified after enrollment
data.text: If a clinically significant finding is identified (including, but not limited to changes from baseline in QT interval corrected using Fridericia's formula [QTcF]) after enrollment, the Investigator or qualified designee will determine if the participant can continue in the study and if any change in participant management is needed.

data.name: Physical Examination Condition Before Discharge
data.description: A physical examination should be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit; symptom-driven exams at Investigator discretion
data.text: A full physical examination will be performed at Screening, at check-in for the study, and at the End of the study/Early Termination Visit. A physical examination should also be performed on any participants with ongoing adverse events prior to discharge from the unit.

data.name: US Screening-Only Site Condition
data.description: Sites in the US may perform only screening procedures and none of the remaining study procedures
data.text: Addition of text applicable only to the US that details the possibility for sites in the US to only perform screening procedures and not any of the remaining study procedures.

data.name: Screening to Enrollment/Run-in Transition
data.text: Participants eligible for the study will be enrolled on Day -7 and initiated on a copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet; participants will be admitted to the CRU for Treatment Period 1 on Day -8.

data.name: Run-in to Treatment Period 1 Transition
data.text: Following the Run-in Period (Day -7 through Day -1, including baseline copper/molybdenum balance collection Day -4 to Day -1), participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day beginning on Day 1 for approximately 28 days.

data.name: Inpatient Period 1 to Outpatient Period Transition
data.text: Participants may be discharged from the CRU on Day 9 to return on Day 22 or Day 23 (predose), or remain in the CRU for their own safety or to maintain the integrity of the conduct of the study.

data.name: Outpatient Period to Inpatient Period 2 Transition
data.text: Participants who are discharged will be re-admitted on Day 22 or Day 23 for Treatment Period 2 and will remain in house until Day 40; all procedures will start on Day 23.

data.name: Dose Escalation to 30 mg/day on Day 29
data.text: Participants will be administered ALXN1840 at 15 mg/day on Day 1 through Day 28 and then increase to 30 mg/day on Day 29 through Day 39, following SRC review of available safety data through Day 23 for each participant.

data.name: Dose Reduction for Hematologic Abnormality
data.text: > 30% decrease from baseline with neutrophils below reference range at baseline: Reduce dose to previous dose level if up-titration has occurred or reduce dose to 15 mg QOD if on 15 mg QD. No further dose increase until resolution of abnormality, with weekly repeat testing.

data.name: Temporary Dose Interruption for Hepatic Abnormality
data.text: Bilirubin > 2 × ULN accompanied by ALT > 3 × ULN, indicative of liver injury: temporary interruption with weekly repeat testing. Rechallenge at 15 mg QOD or less frequent when bilirubin is below ULN, with Alexion Medical Monitor approval.

data.name: Dose Modification for Neurological or Psychiatric Worsening
data.text: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor will evaluate the need for dose modification (interruption, increase or decrease) based on copper control parameters and relevant clinical data; rationale documented and re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Safety Events
data.text: Participants must be considered for discontinuation from study intervention if any of the following occur: serious hypersensitivity reaction; severe uncontrolled infection; use of disallowed medication; pregnancy or planned pregnancy; or Alexion or the Investigator deems it is necessary for the participant.

data.name: Discontinuation of Study Intervention for Abnormal Liver Function
data.text: Discontinuation of study intervention for abnormal liver function should be considered by the Investigator when a participant meets one of the conditions outlined in the Dose Modification criteria (Section 6.6) or if the Investigator believes that it is in best interest of the participant.

data.name: Remain in Study for Safety Follow-up After Intervention Discontinuation
data.text: If the study intervention is definitively discontinued, the participant should remain in the study to be evaluated for safety follow-up.

data.name: Post-Study Therapy Transition
data.text: Following completion of both inpatient periods of the study (ie, Day 40), participants will either: transition to therapy that was discontinued before enrollment, or transition to other standard of care therapy as directed by the treating physician, or at the discretion of the treating physician, consider and request continuation of ALXN1840 treatment permissible under local regulations for preapproval access.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: A participant is considered to have completed the study if he/she has completed all phases of the study including the last scheduled procedure shown in the SoA; all participants should return to the CRU for the EOS Visit on Day 54 (+/- 2 days). End of study is the date the last participant completes the last visit in the SoA.

data.name: Early Termination / Early Discontinuation Visit
data.description: At the time of discontinuation from the study, if possible, an early discontinuation visit (EOS/ET Visit) should be conducted as shown in the SoA; the participant will be permanently discontinued both from the study intervention and from the study at that time.

data.name: Withdrawal by Participant or Investigator
data.description: A participant may withdraw from the study at any time at his/her own request, or may be withdrawn at any time at the discretion of the Investigator for safety, behavioral, compliance, or administrative reasons.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: A participant will be considered lost to follow-up if he or she repeatedly fails to return for scheduled visits and is unable to be contacted by the study site; after documented attempts (where possible, 3 telephone calls and, if necessary, a certified letter to the last known mailing address), a participant who remains unreachable will be considered to have withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Study or Site Termination by Sponsor/Investigator
data.description: Alexion reserves the right to close the study site or terminate the study at any time for any reason; reasons for early closure may include failure of the Investigator to comply with the protocol/IRB/IEC/GCP requirements, inadequate recruitment of participants, or discontinuation of further study intervention development. A site is closed when all participants have completed the end of study or early discontinuation visit.

data.name: Pregnancy
data.description: Pregnancy or planned pregnancy requires consideration for discontinuation from study intervention.

data.name: SRC Safety Review Decision Before Titration
data.description: Before titration to 30 mg/day on Day 29, the SRC reviews available safety data through Day 23 for each participant to determine whether dose escalation may proceed or the participant remains on 15 mg/day.

data.name: CRU Discharge Decision at Day 9
data.description: Decision at Day 9 whether the participant is discharged to the Outpatient Period (returning Day 22 or Day 23) or remains in the CRU for safety or study conduct integrity.

data.name: Outpatient Period Extension Decision
data.description: Investigator decision whether to extend the Outpatient Period up to an additional 14 days, with provision of additional investigational product; participant resumes Inpatient Period 2 at Day 23.

data.name: Dose Modification Decision on Safety Laboratory Results
data.description: At scheduled safety laboratory assessments (Days -8, -1, 8, 23, 28) and weekly repeat testing, dose reduction, interruption, or restriction of dose increase is determined per Table 7 dose modification criteria.

data.name: Neurologic/Psychiatric Dose Decision
data.description: Investigator and Alexion Medical Monitor decision on dose interruption, increase or decrease upon evidence of neurologic or psychiatric worsening, re-evaluated at the next study visit.

data.name: Eligibility/Enrollment Decision at Day -7
data.description: On Day -7, eligible participants are registered, assigned a participant number, and initiated on the copper- and molybdenum-controlled diet.

data.name: End of Study Transition Decision
data.description: At Day 40, decision on post-study therapy: resume pre-enrollment therapy, other standard of care, or request continued ALXN1840 under preapproval access.
